How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHSGSU Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHSGSU Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate-I position at Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Sc. or M. Tech degree in a relevant field of Plant Science or Allied Subjects to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- INR per month, plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DHSGSU Project Associate-I vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all required documents and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Project Associate-I position at DHSGSU?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position is a contractual role. The duration of the contract will be as per the project requirements and institutional norms.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar located?
faq.answer: Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar is located in Sagar, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DHSGU-Bot/ANRF-S21646/34.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Eligible candidates from all regions are encouraged to apply, provided they meet the educational and other criteria.
